summary: Added .pmcro/scripts/queue_adapter.py (pending/processing/done/held/dead states, atomic-rename durability, lease reclamation, bounded retries with dead letters, drain that delegates every decision to the dispatcher) and .pmcro/scripts/ingress.py (payload size bound, intent extraction, contract-valid SeedIntent at low confidence, delivery-id plus payload-hash idempotency key, requires_approval for untrusted origins). Extended pmcro.config.json with queue_lease_seconds, max_queue_attempts, max_ingress_bytes, and an empty trusted_ingress_sources allowlist; ignored .pmcro/queue as per-machine runtime state. Added .pmcro/tests/test_ingress_queue.py with ten gate tests.
